{{Quote|One time, this Hutt was hoarding medpacs after a massive groundquake. Selling them at an obscene markup. I tricked Mandalorians into attacking his palace.|Doc|<ref name="Anonymous" />}}
A '''Hutt''' owned a [[Unidentified Hutt's palace|palace]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Anonymous" /> Sometime between [[3647 BBY|3647]]<ref name="Codex" />&ndash;[[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> after a severe [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where his palace was located, the Hutt began to hoard [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] in his palace and sold them at a high rate in order to profit from the devastation. However, the combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as Doc, forged a false [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] against a local [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (Cold War)|clan]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors in the Hutt's name. As a result, the Mandalorians [[Attack on a Hutt's palace|attacked]] the Hutt's palace, and while both the Hutt and the attacking Mandalorians [[Death/Legends|killed]] each other during the battle, Doc stole medpacs from the palace.<ref name="Anonymous" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed Hutt was first mentioned in the conversation "Anonymous" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Anonymous" />
